annotation.justification: The target clause provides a clear explanation of the purpose and usage of the If-None-Match header in HTTP GET requests. It specifies that clients should include a list of entity-tags in the header to allow servers to respond with 304 (Not Modified) when a match is found. The language does not permit multiple materially different interpretations, nor does it omit a constraint that would affect implementation behavior. Therefore, it is not ambiguous.
